images.description: Connect your Omi. BEFORE: control, step 9, after the voice intro (Back button). AFTER: connect_first, step 4 right after the trial paywall, no Back, same screen and copy as control. Real simulator shots, iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.2.

Every step, light mode. BEFORE: control as shipped (this branch with the flag unassigned). AFTER: connect_first with no Omi paired: Connect is step 4 and the voice intro stays at the end. Real simulator shots.

AFTER, Omi paired at Connect: 4 progress dots, Permissions leads straight to Home, no voice intro. SIMULATED pairing: the simulator has no Bluetooth, so the shoot writes the saved, connected Omi a real pairing leaves.
AFTER in dark mode: Connect (step 4), Name, voice intro. Real simulator shots.

AFTER at the largest accessibility text size (accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large, set after sign-in): Connect (step 4, no Back) and Name. The Connect screen is the same as control's step 9: at this size it breaks its title, hides the subtitle and truncates two button labels; all three actions stay on screen and Skip moved on to Name. Real simulator shots.

AFTER in German, Japanese and Arabic (right to left): Connect (step 4, no Back) and Name, app language from the first launch's language (what Settings > Language also writes). "Skip for Now" is English in all three: an existing translation gap, same in control. Real simulator shots.
